rule: A decision is accepted only with a real signoff and an Accepted ADR. Everything else stays open. Placeholders are not signoffs.

issue23.title: C-05 Record the cloud gate decisions
issue23.finding: Closure is not evidence of decisions. Neither promised ADR exists, and ADR numbers 0004 and 0005 now name different Proposed ADRs. controls.yaml holds test ownership only, with no D-id cross-reference or signoff.

decisions.question: Legal residency and processing regions
decisions.blockingCapability: Live rollout outside the dev project; managed memory; regional model inference
decisions.note: ADR 0003 fixes the dev pilot region asia-northeast1 only. It is not a production residency decision.

decisions.question: Pilot users, tenancy and sensitivity
decisions.blockingCapability: Any user population beyond the test tenant; cross-segment persistence changes
decisions.note: ADR 0003 names a test tenant with Alice, Bob and a reviewer group. No classification or named production teams are recorded.

decisions.question: Priority data sources
decisions.blockingCapability: Retrieval over any real source; source-backed answers in production
decisions.note: ADR 0003 builds no retrieval and names a Google Docs draft as the first write target. No source inventory or quotas are recorded.

decisions.question: Gemini Enterprise licensing vs Agent Platform custom approach
decisions.blockingCapability: Choice of managed retrieval arm; managed service adoption
decisions.note: ADR 0003 only says arm B runs if there is no Gemini Enterprise trial. The promised managed-services ADR does not exist.

decisions.question: Source ACL freshness and revocation requirements
decisions.blockingCapability: Source-access preservation through reads, citations and memory (SEC-02); ACL-01 live evidence
decisions.note: No O item covers it. The measurement belongs to ACL-01.

decisions.question: Agent Gateway / Registry availability for selected topology
decisions.blockingCapability: Any dependency on Agent Gateway or Registry; out-of-process connectors
decisions.note: Deny-by-default integration test and region check are not recorded.

decisions.question: OAuth scope / consent workflow
decisions.blockingCapability: DEP-01 and every live Workspace write scope
decisions.note: No admin approval or security verification is recorded.

decisions.question: Exact audit/retention and deletion rules
decisions.blockingCapability: Retention and deletion enforcement (P3-RET); source retention; managed memory
decisions.note: No records schedule or privacy assessment is recorded.

decisions.question: Allowed model families and inference endpoints
decisions.blockingCapability: Production model selection; regional inference endpoints
decisions.note: ADR 0003 sets the pilot region only. No benchmark, terms or price review is recorded.

decisions.question: Workload size and availability objectives
decisions.blockingCapability: Promotion of provisional targets P01-P08 to approved SLOs; production approval
decisions.note: RFC section 1.3 states no throughput, RTO or RPO was supplied. Pack targets are provisional.

decisions.question: Whether agents may create/schedule work without direct user prompt
decisions.note: No delegation charter or revocation semantics are recorded.

decisions.question: Operations that need dual approval
decisions.blockingCapability: Approval exemptions; sensitive effects that require dual approval
decisions.note: No risk classification or separation-of-duties policy is recorded.
